content.intro: This lesson introduces dependency compatibility and reproducible environments as part of virtual environments, dependencies, and packaging. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Organize reusable code and its dependencies deliberately. Test from the project root, pin or constrain dependencies intentionally, and document supported Python versions.
